messages.content: Seiso is a local-first AI platform for running, training, and exporting open models on your own hardware.
How do I fine-tune a model?
Use `seiso train -c configs/example_lora.yaml` or open Training Studio in Forge after downloading a safetensors snapshot from the Model Hub.
Can I use QLoRA on macOS?
macOS uses 16-bit LoRA via PyTorch MPS or CPU. QLoRA 4-bit requires NVIDIA CUDA or Linux with bitsandbytes.
Distill-RL aligns a student model with teacher KL distillation plus DPO preference fine-tuning inside Seiso Studio.
